```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Setup

Libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(janitor)
library(ggtext)
library(lubridate)

```

## Data
```{r}
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load('2025-06-24')

cases_month <- tuesdata$cases_month
cases_year <- tuesdata$cases_year

```


## Tidy & Explore

```{r}
cases_month |> 
  select(country, year, month, measles_total)

cases_month |> 
  summarise(min_year = min(year), 
            max_year = max(year))

cases_month |> 
  count(country, year)

cases_month |> 
  group_by(country) |> 
  summarise(n = n())

```

```{r}
cases_month |> 
  filter(country %in% c("United States of America", "Canada", "Mexico")) |> 
  mutate(date_clean = make_date(year, month)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date_clean, y = measles_total, color = country)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_grid(~country)

cases_year |> 
  filter(country %in% c("United States of America", "Canada", "Mexico")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = measles_total, color = country)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_grid(~country)

cases_year |> 
  filter(country %in% c("United States of America", "Canada")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = measles_total, fill = country)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  facet_grid(~country)

```
